transcript.text: Good morning everyone. Before I issue today's vehicle assignments and dispatch board, let's have our transport-board huddle. I need the transportation, medical, signal, and engineer representatives to report any load or vehicle-control requirements for today's four moves: the clinic cold-storage cases to the medical annex, the communications mast to the north relay point, the generator to the engineering yard, and the routine administrative pallets to the headquarters warehouse. Please speak up now with any constraints or requirements I should know about.

I received the corrected dimensions during yesterday's vehicle check, but I should note the revised load sheet hasn't been posted to the dispatch board yet.
